title: .security-scan.toml
description: A project's scan policy for valvur, committed with the project (D10, D11): what the scan reads, and the risks the project has accepted. Machine settings live in ~/.config/valvur/config.toml instead.

exclude.description: Root-relative path prefixes no Scanner reads, matched on whole segments. An exclusion hides a directory from every Scanner: name only what is not source.

history.description: Read git history for secrets (D3). On by default.

scope.description: `git` reads the git view (the default); `tree` walks the working tree, ignored files included.

sbom.description: Write the SBOM (sbom.cdx.json) and check dependency licences from it. Off by default.

suppress.description: Accepted risks, each reviewed by a human and expiring (F8).

expires.description: A TOML date; the suppression lapses after it.

reason.description: Why the risk is accepted, for the reviewer.
